instruction: Cinematic low-angle medium shot of an outdoor concrete wall against a clear blue sky. On the left, the boy in the tie-dye shirt (R2) crouches on the wall, smiling and gesturing with his hand near his face. On the right, the boy in the pink striped shirt (R1) sits beside him, pointing upward while looking at his friend. Bright daylight casts natural shadows under a vivid blue sky.
